project: SmartDoc 智能文档助手 — V1.2 开发任务

tasks.name: Add @Size(max=2000) validation to ChatReq.message
tasks.description: 给 ChatReq.message 字段补充 @Size(max=2000) 注解，防止超长输入导致 LLM Token 过高

tasks.name: Implement concurrent session conflict control
tasks.description: 使用 ConcurrentHashMap + AtomicBoolean 实现会话级锁，同一 sessionId 并发请求时后一个返回 503

tasks.name: Implement structured SSE error events
tasks.description: 将 emitter.completeWithError() 替换为发送结构化 JSON 错误事件 data:{"error":"..."} 后正常 complete()

tasks.name: Fix document upload error handling
tasks.description: 上传接口区分错误类型：格式不支持 → HTTP 400，解析/向量化失败 → HTTP 500，而非统一 200 + AjaxResult.failed()

tasks.name: Build and verify compilation
tasks.description: 运行 mvn compile -DskipTests 验证所有修改编译通过
